faqs.q: What is a 2-inch Fig.1502 turbine flowmeter used for?
faqs.a: It is a 2-inch turbine flowmeter for high-pressure frac and cementing service, with Fig.1502 F×M connections at 15,000 psi MAWP and an optical or magnetic pickup output. See the [turbine flowmeters shelf](/c/ic-turbine-flowmeters).

faqs.q: What does Fig.1502 F×M mean on the turbine flowmeter?
faqs.a: Fig.1502 is the hammer-union connection style, and F×M means the meter has a female end and a male end. The listing gives 15,000 psi MAWP.

faqs.q: What sizes does the turbine flowmeter come in?
faqs.a: This listing is 2-inch. The listing also says 3-inch and lower-pressure variants are available. Tell us the application and we check it against the specification.

faqs.q: What pressure is the turbine flowmeter rated for?
faqs.a: 15,000 psi MAWP (maximum allowable working pressure) with the Fig.1502 F×M connections. Do not run it above this figure. Tell us the application and we check it against the specification.

faqs.q: What output does the turbine flowmeter give?
faqs.a: An optical or magnetic pickup output, with a K-factor calibration certificate. The K-factor is the number of pulses per unit volume of fluid.

faqs.q: Is NACE MR-0175 available on the turbine flowmeter?
faqs.a: NACE MR-0175 materials are available on request for sour-service applications. Say so when you order. If you are unsure, send us the requirement and we will confirm.

faqs.q: How does the turbine flowmeter connect to a data system?
faqs.a: Through the pickup output into a [data acquisition system](/c/ic-data-acquisition), which counts the pulses and uses the K-factor to give flow. Send us the details and we confirm the specification before supply.

faqs.q: How do I choose the turbine flowmeter size?
faqs.a: Match the meter bore to the line and flow range, 2-inch here or 3-inch on request. See the [oilfield instrumentation guide](/blog/oilfield-pressure-and-flow-instrumentation). If you are unsure, send us the requirement and we will confirm.

faqs.q: What do I need to tell Indus to quote the the 2-inch turbine flowmeter?
faqs.a: Quote the full title, Turbine Flowmeter, 2-inch Fig.1502 F×M, 15,000 psi, Frac / Cementing Service, with the variant, size or voltage you need, and say where it will be used and which standard or zone applies. We confirm the specification and lead time on the quotation; start on [our contact page](/contact).

faqs.q: Turbine or Coriolis flowmeter: which should I choose?
faqs.a: The turbine meter measures volume flow at 15,000 psi, while the [Coriolis NRD meter](/p/coriolis-mass-flowmeter-nrd-2-inch-cementing-service-local-remote-display) gives mass flow, density and temperature. Choose Coriolis when density matters.

faqs.q: Where is the turbine flowmeter supplied from?
faqs.a: We supply it from Dubai, UAE and ship worldwide. Send the size, connection and pressure. Send us the details and we confirm the specification before supply.

faqs.q: Is the 2-inch turbine flowmeter in stock in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes. In Dubai, UAE we stock the 2-inch turbine flowmeter and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Tell us sizes and quantities on [our contact page](/contact) and we will quote.
